newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST-POLISH ZLOTY SEEN AT 3.4057 VS DLR END-97.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-POLISH ZLOTY SEEN AT 3.4057 VS DLR END-97.

text.p: The Polish zloty is seen easing against the dollar by the end of the year and the prediction is more pessimistic than last month, according to a Reuter poll of the country's 26 largest banks.
By the end of 1997 the zloty is expected to fall to 3.4057 to the dollar versus Monday's fixing of 3.0830, the poll showed.
The end-1997 prediction is a mean average of forecasts that ranged between 3.2000 and 4.0000.
Last month, banks predicted a fall in the Polish unit to 3.3757 at year-end with forecast ranging from 3.2100 to 3.8000.

Banks estimated the zloty would fall to an average of 3.1040 against the dollar at the end of March with a range from 3.0750 to 3.1485 and to 3.4546 to the dollar in March 1998 with a range of forecasts from 3.2500 to 4.1200.
